scheme_name: Krushak Assistance For Livelihood And Income Augmentation
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Odisha
Applicant must be engaged in agricultural activities such as farming, cultivation, horticulture, or animal husbandry as a landowner, tenant farmer, or sharecropper
Household should be categorized as "deprived" or "vulnerable" under the Socio‑Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 or any other state government survey
Applicant must own cultivable land or be a sharecropper/tenant farmer cultivating someone else's land
Applicant must have a bank account in his/her name and a valid Aadhaar number linked to the account
Applicant must not have any criminal record or involvement in illegal activities
There is no age limit for applying
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to Rs 12,500 for landless agricultural households and Rs 10,000 per family for vulnerable cultivators, along with insurance cover and low‑interest loans.
